name: promo-video
description: Narrated promo / feature-announcement videos for Telegram and Instagram in Russian or English from one prompt: real UI captured with Playwright, ElevenLabs voice-over with word timing and objective take selection (Scribe error rate + pitch range), scenes cut on the narration, word-highlighted captions, platform-safe 9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1 layouts, fade-through transitions, MP4 + post text.
